The notes follow the two halves of the course: Part 2 (Ser Wee, Weeks 7–13: channel, detection, diversity, MIMO, equalisation, OFDM) and the three blocks A/B/C of Part 1 (cellular networks, wireless systems, satellite). Each tab above is a complete learning page; for exercises, switch to "Practice" at the top right.讲解按课程分成两部分：Part 2（Ser Wee，第 7–13 周，信道、检测、分集、MIMO、均衡、OFDM），以及 Part 1 的 A/B/C 三块（蜂窝网络、无线系统、卫星）。上面每个标签是一份完整的讲解页；做题请切到右上角的「练习」。

Final-exam rules stated by the lecturers

  • Part 2: memorise the blue-box formulas in the notes; unboxed formulas are given in the exam, but you must know what the symbols mean; no integration; marks are given per step, and you lose marks if you do not show the dB ↔ linear conversion.Part 2：讲义里蓝框公式要背，没框的公式考试会给但要懂符号含义；不考积分；按步骤给分，dB ↔ 线性换算不写会扣分。
  • Part 2 final questions come from Practice questions or worked examples in the notes, or variations of them; mastering the notes and the 7 Practice sheets is enough, no outside material needed. The lecturer said his two questions are harder than the Quiz.Part 2 期末题出自 Practice 题或讲义例题，或它们的变形；把讲义和 7 份 Practice 吃透就够，不用看课外材料。老师说他出的两题比 Quiz 难。
  • The pink "▶ Lecturer's emphasis in class" boxes on each learning page collect the key points from the lecture recordings; the matching past-exam questions are at the end of each chapter.每份讲解页里粉色的「▶ 老师课上强调」框，是按上课录音整理的重点；章末附了对应的历年真题。
  • Every section has a "▶ Animation": in a wide window it sits to the right of the text and follows you as you scroll; on a phone or narrow window it is under the section heading. For step-by-step figures, click "Next ▶" to go through one step at a time; for figures with sliders, drag them to change the parameters and watch how the result changes.每一小节都配了「▶ 动画示意」：窗口够宽时在正文右边，跟着你往下滚；手机或窄窗口时在小节标题下面。分步的点「下一步 ▶」一步步看，带滑块的可以拖动改参数，看结果怎么变。

Suggested revision order

  1. Part 2: Ch. 6 equalisation and Ch. 7 OFDM are tested every year, so start there; then Ch. 4 diversity and Ch. 5 MIMO; finally review Ch. 2–3.Part 2：第 6 章均衡和第 7 章 OFDM 每年必考，先看；再看第 4 章分集、第 5 章 MIMO，最后回顾第 2–3 章。
  2. Ch. 1b–2 problem types: the 13 types of channel calculation question, each with a symbol table, formulas and a step table; good for a quick run-through.第 1b–2 章题型总结：信道部分的 13 类计算题，每类有符号表、公式和步骤表，适合快速过一遍。
  3. Part A: focus on Erlang B/C table look-up, frequency reuse and SIR, cell splitting and sectoring.Part A：重点在 Erlang B/C 查表、频率复用和 SIR、小区分裂与扇区化。
  4. Part B and Part C: material for the Q4 short answers; memorising the key points is enough.Part B 和 Part C：Q4 简答的素材，背要点即可。
  5. After each block, go to "Practice" and do the matching Practice sheet and past-exam questions.每学完一块，到「练习」做对应的 Practice 和历年真题。
